thread:
sam_sales: Prospect (payments) needs EU + SG country-level residency for a short POC. They want a subprocessor list, routing order, and confirmation that hosted endpoints can be constrained to country borders for test. Also asked about pricing uplift for regional pinning.

rita_solutions: Quick q: POC BYOK or platform keys? control-plane isolation?

sam_sales: POC ok with platform keys but wants auditable evidence of no-cross-border egress. Production will require BYOK and contractual residency.

omar_sre: Ops: hosted default routing= same-country -> same-region -> nearest-region. We can enable a "strict-region" flag for the POC to reject requests instead of failing over. That satisfies the no-egress test. Note: control-plane telemetry may still contact central endpoints; we can limit/mask it and provide an attestation for the POC. Private deployment needed for zero control-plane egress.

omar_sre: We'll provide a pcap-friendly test script and network trace checklist.

rita_solutions: Example header to pin requests:
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Host: api.redwood.com
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
X-Redwood-Region: ap-southeast-1
X-Redwood-Strict-Region: true
```

zara_pm: Subprocessors: cloud infra (region-specific), logging vendor (we can use EU/APAC-only endpoints), monitoring agent (can disable for POC), CDN (if used). Legal addendum required to claim EU-only SLA.

legal_mike: We'll export subprocessor CSV and provide DPA addendum draft. BYOK onboarding for EU: ~3-7 business days post-contract. For production zero-US control-plane guarantees require Private/on-prem.

omar_sre: Pricing: POC short eval no uplift using hosted+strict flag. Sustained regional pin (Dedicated reservation) uplift ~+22% to +38% vs baseline depending on GPU and locality. BYOK & retention/attestation = additional fixed PS fee.

infra_bot: Ticket RED-POC-4412 created with runbook https://internal.redwood/presales/RED-POC-4412. Assigned @omar_sre @rita_solutions.

sam_sales: Customer asks for (1) one-page subprocessor summary + CSV, (2) attestation that POC will reject cross-border failover with test traces. Can we deliver by EOD tomorrow?

rita_solutions: I'll draft one-pager + test script.

omar_sre: I'll draft attestation and ops checklist (IP allowlist, header enforcement, telemetry mask). Will include cost delta text.

legal_mike: I'll export CSV and draft DPA addendum template.

zara_pm: Sync call Fri 10:30 SGT to review deliverables.

sam_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup:
